record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764> on Neginoth<WH05058>, A Psalm<WH04210> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> Hear<WH06030><WTH8798> me when I call<WH07121><WTH8800>, O God<WH0430> of my righteousness<WH06664>: thou hast enlarged<WH07337><WTH8689> me <FI>when I was<Fi> in distress<WH06862>; have mercy<WH02603><WTH8798> upon me, and hear<WH08085><WTH8798> my prayer<WH08605>. <RF>chief...: or, overseer<Rf> <RF>have...: or, be gracious unto me<Rf>

O ye sons<WH01121> of men<WH0376>, how long<WH05704> <FI>will ye turn<Fi> my glory<WH03519> into shame<WH03639>? <FI>how long<Fi> will ye love<WH0157><WTH8799> vanity<WH07385>, <FI>and<Fi> seek<WH01245><WTH8762> after leasing<WH03577>? Selah<WH05542>.

But know<WH03045><WTH8798> that the LORD<WH03068> hath set apart<WH06395><WTH8689> him that is godly<WH02623> for himself: the LORD<WH03068> will hear<WH08085><WTH8799> when I call<WH07121><WTH8800> unto him.
Stand in awe<WH07264><WTH8798>, and sin<WH02398><WTH8799> not: commune<WH0559><WTH8798> with your own heart<WH03824> upon your bed<WH04904>, and be still<WH01826><WTH8798>. Selah<WH05542>.
Offer<WH02076><WTH8798> the sacrifices<WH02077> of righteousness<WH06664>, and put your trust<WH0982><WTH8798> in the LORD<WH03068>.<CM>

<FI> There be<Fi> many<WH07227> that say<WH0559><WTH8802>, Who will shew<WH07200><WTH8686> us <FI>any<Fi> good<WH02896>? LORD<WH03068>, lift thou up<WH05375><WTH8798> the light<WH0216> of thy countenance<WH06440> upon us.
Thou hast put<WH05414><WTH8804> gladness<WH08057> in my heart<WH03820>, more than in the time<WH06256> <FI>that<Fi> their corn<WH01715> and their wine<WH08492> increased<WH07231><WTH8804>.
I will both<WH03162> lay me down<WH07901><WTH8799> in peace<WH07965>, and sleep<WH03462><WTH8799>: for thou, LORD<WH03068>, only<WH0910> makest me dwell<WH03427><WTH8686> in safety<WH0983>.<CM>
